Title: Azure Mobile Apps iOS SDK v3.3.0 released

Body.Content:
Today we are releasing the Azure Mobile Apps iOS SDK to CocoaPods and other online properties. This is a drop-in replacement for the existing SDK. We only have one feature fix in this release. We updated the authentication code to support the SFSafariVewController.

​Read more details and view some code snippets in our team's blog post.
